title: Event passes
archivedHint: This event is archived. Unarchive it to issue passes.
disabledBody: Ask your platform administrator to switch on Event Passes for your school.

stat.checkInsDenied: {count, plural, one {# person checked in} other {# people checked in}} · {denied} refused

list.tierCount: {passes, plural, one {# pass} other {# passes}}, {people} people
list.emptyBody: Issue a pass with a parent's mobile and their details fill in automatically.
list.selectedN: {count, plural, one {# pass selected} other {# passes selected}}

print.nothing: None of the selected passes can be printed.
print.done: {count, plural, one {# pass} other {# passes}} on {sheets, plural, one {# A4 sheet} other {# A4 sheets}}. Print at 100% and cut along the lines.
print.failed: Could not prepare the passes for printing.

history.title: Gate history · {serial}
history.subtitle: Every check-in, check-out and refusal, and who decided.
history.empty: This pass has not been used at the gate yet.
history.in: {people, plural, one {Checked in # person} other {Checked in # people}}
history.out: {people, plural, one {Checked out # person} other {Checked out # people}}

cancel.title: Cancel pass {serial}
cancel.explain: The pass stops working at the gate straight away and disappears from the parent's phone. This cannot be undone.

reissue.title: Reissue pass {serial}
reissue.explain: The pass gets a new QR code. Any earlier printout stops working; print the pass again. The parent's phone shows the new code.

checkOut.title: Check out pass {serial}
checkOut.explain: Use this when the party left without being scanned out. It is recorded with your name.
checkOut.failed: Could not check out the pass.

form.subtitle: Enter the parent's mobile first: the linked students and the parent's name fill in automatically.
form.mobileHint: Optional. The pass also appears on this parent's phone.
form.notLinked: This mobile is not linked to any student. You can still issue a guest pass.
form.alreadyHas: {count, plural, one {This mobile already has pass {serials} for this event.} other {This mobile already has passes {serials} for this event.}}
form.addNamesHint: Shown on the pass and to the guard at the gate.
form.allDaysHint: {count} days. Turn off to choose specific days.
form.remarksHint: Only staff see this, at the gate and here.
form.pickDay: Choose at least one day, or make the pass valid on all days.

scan.actionFailed: That did not go through. Please try again.
scan.checkedIn: {people, plural, one {Checked in # person} other {Checked in # people}}
scan.checkedInDetail: Recorded with your name. Scan the pass again when they leave.
scan.checkedOutDetail: Recorded with your name. The pass can be used to enter again.
scan.validDetail: Tick or count who is entering now; the rest can enter later.
scan.replacedDetail: This printout was reported lost and a new one was issued. Ask for the new pass.
scan.noNames: Names not given on this pass.
scan.checkOut: {people, plural, one {Check out (# person)} other {Check out (# people)}}
scan.cannotAllow: This pass cannot be let in. Record the refusal.
scan.denyHint: Recorded with your name. A reason helps the office.

reason.idMismatch: Person does not match the pass
